RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This lease is between Property Holdings LLC (Landlord) and the undersigned Tenant for a unit in Los Angeles, California.

1. The monthly rent is $2,000, due on the 1st of the month.
2. The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $6,000 which is non-refundable under all circumstances.
3. A late fee of $150 per day applies to any rent received after the due date.
4. The Landlord may enter the premises at any time without notice, day or night, for inspection or any other purpose.
5. The Landlord may terminate this lease at any time for any reason with 24 hours notice, and the Tenant must vacate immediately.
6. The Tenant waives the right to a jury trial and agrees that all disputes shall be decided by an arbitrator selected solely by the Landlord.
7. The Tenant is responsible for all repairs including structural repairs, roof repairs, and habitability issues at the Tenant's own expense.
8. A penalty of $100 per nail hole will be deducted from the deposit at move-out.
9. Guests may not stay overnight more than one night per month, and any guest stay requires advance written approval.
10. The Tenant agrees never to contact any government authority or housing inspector regarding the premises, and any such contact is grounds for immediate eviction.
11. This lease automatically renews for a further 12 month term unless the Tenant provides 90 days notice of non-renewal.
